MDG.note: The regulator named is the CSBF, a banking supervision commission, not stated to be the central bank.

facts.fact: Under article 101 of banking law 2020-011 the CSBF regulates and controls e-money institutions, ensures user protection and can sanction breaches up to withdrawal of licence; article 158 lets consumer associations go to court.

systems.owner: Commission de supervision bancaire et financiere

MDG.note: Powers are described, with no sanction or complaint figure and no complaints unit, so no redress or enforced fact.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: Banking law 2020-011 governs e-money institutions, giving the CSBF power to regulate and control them, inspect their distribution agents and withdraw licences.

MDG.note: E-money is discussed as regulated, but no service in use is described.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
